# Merge-AutopilotHashCsv

<!-- Generated by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Edit the script header, not this file. -->

Combines multiple Autopilot hardware-hash CSVs into one de-duplicated CSV.

| | |
|---|---|
| Location | `scripts/windows/endpoint/Merge-AutopilotHashCsv.ps1` |
| Platform | Windows (works on macOS with PowerShell 7) |
| Permissions | None (file access only) |
| Safety | Read-only on inputs; writes one new file |

## When to use

After collecting hardware hashes from several devices, before the Intune Autopilot import.

## Description

Reads every *.csv in the input folder, de-duplicates on "Device Serial Number" and writes one combined CSV
ready to import into Intune/Autopilot. The combined file is written to the output folder, not the input
folder, so re-running never re-reads an earlier result.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-InputPath` | String | Yes | Folder containing the individual hash CSVs (e.g. from Get-WindowsAutopilotInfo). |
| `-OutputPath` | String | No | Folder for the combined CSV. Falls back to $env:TOOLBOX_REPORT_DIR, then prompts. |
| `-CustomerName` | String | No | Optional. Adds a &lt;OutputPath&gt;\&lt;CustomerName&gt; subfolder. |
| `-KeyColumn` | String | No | Column used to de-duplicate. Default "Device Serial Number". |

## Examples

```powershell
.\Merge-AutopilotHashCsv.ps1 -InputPath D:\Autopilot\Incoming -OutputPath D:\Reports
```

```powershell
.\Merge-AutopilotHashCsv.ps1 -InputPath D:\Autopilot\Incoming -OutputPath D:\Reports -CustomerName Contoso
```
